name: What are the benefits of installing a multi-height countertop?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of installing a multi-height countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-height countertops offer several advantages. They can improve ergonomics, allowing for comfortable food preparation at a standard height and a seating area at bar height. This design adds visual depth and a custom feel to the kitchen. It also helps define spaces without the need for walls, making open-concept layouts more functional. For homes in the Bay Area, where space optimization is key, this design can enhance both utility and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include improved ergonomics, defined functional zones, added visual interest, and a custom kitchen feel.
